text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Intense drowsiness detected. Cause: 
Failure of Operation 'Count Sheep.'
choice_data_list:
You mean counting sheep until you fall 
asleep?

The counting sheep until you fall asleep 
thing?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. For some reason, the sleep 
method my father taught me directly didn't 
work.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I kept counting... one sheep doing a leg 
press... two sheep doing front lunges——

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just as the sheep completed its 21,600th 
hip extension... it was time to wake up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...Considering the burden on the sheep, 
perhaps we should have gone with swim 
training?"

She seems to be genuinely troubled in her 
own way about not being able to fall 
asleep easily...
